cards.title: Core schemas and ledger architecture of the Finance module
cards.body:
The Finance module operates primarily within the Finance and masterdata schemas.
General Ledger entries reside in Finance.FJournalMaster and Finance.FJournalDetail tables.
Account Determination Rules persist within the Finance.ARDMain and ARDItemRule schemas.

cards.title: Automated account determination engine and posting resolution logic
cards.body:
Transactions invoke Finance.FARDFillValues to evaluate applicable posting account rules.
The ARD engine queries ARDVendorLocationRule and ARDItemSubGroupRule to resolve debit and credit accounts.
Resolution failure blocks transaction persistence and returns unmapped account determination errors.

cards.title: Finance book partitioning and accounting period lock mechanisms
cards.body:
Finance books partition ledgers into independent reporting entities linked by FinanceBookId.
Fiscal years and periods map through Finance.fFBPeriodMapping linked to masterdata.mCalendarPeriod.
Posting procedures query period status flags and abort transactions targeting closed accounting periods.

cards.title: Double-entry balancing invariants and voucher generation mechanics
cards.body:
Voucher generation procedures enforce strict double-entry equality between debits and credits.
Unbalanced distributions trigger mathematical invariant exceptions that abort the transaction commit.
Posted vouchers write audit keys back to source operational tables to prevent duplicate financial booking.

cards.title: TDC tax calculation architecture and itemized posting distributions
cards.body:
Tax computations execute through centralized procedures linked to Finance.TDCTransactionDetail.
The tax engine computes IGST, CGST, and SGST based on CompanyStateId versus VendorStateId.
Calculated tax amounts write to discrete ledger clearing accounts specified by TDC account rules.

cards.title: Optimistic locking and diagnostic voucher rebuilding routines
cards.body:
Finance tables enforce optimistic concurrency using ModifiedDate and ModifiedBy record stamps.
Diagnostic shortcut routines Ctrl+Alt+V invoke voucher regeneration scripts for authorized records.
Transactions run within serialized isolation levels during month-end closing and ledger consolidation.
